injuries.detail: Antetokounmpo (groin) won't play in Sunday's game against Oklahoma City, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
Embiid (illness) is out for Monday's game against Portland, Austin Krell of OnPattison.com reports.
Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
